difficulty_reason: The lemma says that under the comparison situation, hypothesis (V_n) implies R^i f_{tau',*} epsilon_{X,*} F = epsilon_{Y,*} R^i f_{tau,*} F for i at most n (statement lines 6913-6919). The proof is a substantial spectral sequence induction: after turning the commutative diagram of the morphism epsilon into a comparison of derived pushforwards and truncating it by (V_n) (proof lines 6922-6938), the author displays the second page of the relative Leray spectral sequence (proof lines 6938-6961) and proves the graded statements (C_m) by induction, showing that the terms with p > 0 and small q vanish (proof lines 6962-6988); the top degree needs a separate argument in which the only surviving differential gives a short exact sequence whose first map is forced to be an isomorphism by the sheaf property and the vanishing of the higher direct images (proof lines 6990-7017). The non-formal content is the two-page bookkeeping and the top-degree argument. The claim is H2: a structured induction with every input named.
